name: Storyblok
description: Storyblok is a headless CMS with a visual, drag-and-drop editor that serves developers with API-first architecture and marketers with intuitive content editing.
best_for: Teams that want a headless CMS combining a developer-friendly, component-based architecture with a visual editor marketers can use directly.

tiers.name: Starter (Free)
tiers.notes: 1 user seat (max 2 with a paid add-on at $15/month each), 100GB traffic/month, 100,000 API requests/month.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: About $90.75/month if paid annually. 5 seats (up to 10 with add-ons), 400GB traffic, 1,000,000 API requests. Overages are sold metered: extra traffic and API requests cost more per block.

tiers.name: Growth Plus
tiers.notes: About $319.91/month if paid annually. 15 seats, a hard cap with no further seat purchases on this plan. Comes with a 45-day free trial.

tiers.name: Premium / Elite
tiers.notes: Contact sales; adds SSO, a formal uptime SLA, GraphQL API access, and A/B testing.

cons: Pricing is per-space, not per-organization, and every dimension (seats, traffic, API calls, locales) has a hard ceiling with paid metered overages once exceeded.

Seat caps are hard-capped per plan regardless of willingness to pay more: Growth tops out at 10 seats total even with paid add-ons, and Growth Plus tops out at 15 seats with no way to purchase additional seats at all -- teams that outgrow this must move to custom Enterprise pricing.
SSO, a formal uptime SLA, GraphQL API access, and A/B testing are reserved for the custom-priced Premium/Elite tiers and are not available at any published self-serve price point.
features: Visual, drag-and-drop editor with on-page collaboration
Global, reusable components and flexible content structures
API-first architecture with REST, GraphQL, and Management APIs
MCP server for agentic, AI-driven content access
FlowMotion workflow orchestration for agent-driven publishing tasks
Framework support including Next.js, Astro, Nuxt, React, and Vue
ISO 27001 security certification and 99.99% uptime SLA

alternatives.name: Contentful
alternatives.description: A headless CMS providing structured content management and delivery through APIs for web and mobile apps.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing an enterprise-ready headless CMS with strong API tooling

alternatives.name: Sanity
alternatives.description: A headless CMS built around structured content and a real-time collaborative editing environment.
alternatives.best_for: Developer teams wanting real-time collaboration and customizable editing tools

alternatives.name: Strapi
alternatives.description: An open-source, TypeScript-based headless CMS that lets developers build content APIs without vendor lock-in.
alternatives.best_for: Developers wanting full data ownership and a self-hostable headless CMS
